about: An inner #![allow(<lint>)], directly or in a cfg_attr arm, is a suppression keyed clippy:<lint> or rustc:<lint>, clippy::disallowed_methods included (the crate root's test switch); an outer #[allow] is clippy's allow_attributes to deny, and an allow in a string or a comment is no site (2.1-Q216, 2.1-M187)
